title: Certified Medical Assistant - Remote Primary Care Coordinator (Monday–Friday 10:
description:
Pine Park Health is a value-based primary care practice revolutionizing healthcare for senior living community residents. We empower seniors to get healthy, stay healthy, and lead lives they love through a care model designed with everyone in mind - patients, families, community staff, providers, and payers.
Our approach brings healthcare directly to seniors' homes, offering prevention, screening, chronic condition management, lab work, and diagnostic testing in the comfort of their apartments. With weekly community visits, our teams provide consistent care while collaborating closely with facility staff to address comprehensive health needs. We've eliminated unnecessary barriers to urgent care through same/next-day appointments, helping seniors avoid emergency rooms and hospitalizations where they risk exposure to additional health concerns.
Today, over 185+ communities across Arizona, California, and Nevada trust Pine Park Health , and we're rapidly expanding our reach and impact.
If you're mission-driven and passionate about transforming senior healthcare, this is your opportunity to make a meaningful difference!

*** Work schedule Monday-Friday 10:00 am-7:00pm PST **
The Opportunity:
The Primary Care Coordinator is the operational and relational backbone of our geriatric primary care team. You will own care coordination for a panel of 500-600 patients - managing real-time communication, triaging urgent clinical needs, maintaining documentation integrity, and serving as the trusted point of contact for patients, families, facility staff, and providers.
This is not a passive coordination role. You will make real-time judgment calls that directly affect patient safety outcomes. The seniors we serve are medically complex, often frightened, and counting on someone who shows up fully - every shift, every call, every task.
What you'll do:

• Serve as the primary point of contact for patients, families, facility partners, and providers across your assigned patient panel

• Triage and prioritize urgent care requests, STAT tasks, and time-sensitive clinical communications in real time

• Maintain accurate, compliant patient documentation within our EMR system

• Proactively manage appointment scheduling, follow-up care, and interdisciplinary communication

• Lead new patient onboarding, ensuring each patient is contacted and scheduled within 24 hours of enrollment

• Participate in after-hours on-call rotation to support continuity of care

• Contribute to quality improvement initiatives and operational efficiency projects

How We Measure Success
Patient Communication & Responsiveness

• 95% of inbound calls answered within 60 seconds (~30 calls/day)

• Average caller wait time under 30 seconds; maximum not to exceed 2 minutes

• Urgent voicemails resolved within 1 hour; non-urgent within 1 business day

• After-hours voicemails addressed within 2 hours of next business day open

Care Coordination & Task Management

• 95% of clinical messages and emails addressed within 2 hours

• Routine tasks completed within 7 days; STAT tasks within 24 hours

• 100% of daily visit reminder calls completed (~20 calls/day)

Documentation & Quality

• Minimum 6 hours of care coordination activity logged daily

• Patient satisfaction scores of 8.5/10 or higher

• Full compliance with HIPAA, CMS, and OIG requirements at all times

Qualifications:

•
2+ years of direct patient care experience in a clinical setting (Medical Assistant, LVN/LPN, CNA, Phlebotomist, Patient Care Technician, or similar role)

•
Experience in healthcare coordination , patient services, or clinical operations

•
Geriatric, Medicare Advantage, or value-based care experience strongly preferred

•
Strong triage and prioritization skills in high-volume, real-time environments

•
Proficiency with EMR/EHR systems and healthcare technology platforms

•
Exceptional communication skills across diverse stakeholders (patients, families, physicians, facility leadership)

•
Self-directed

description:
Who are we?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

Key Overview:
As a Member of Technical Staff in Post-Training, you will train our large language models (LLMs) with reinforcement learning and develop methods that help them generalize beyond the distribution they were trained on. You will design the training recipes, environments, and evaluations that tell us whether a model has truly learned a skill or has only fitted its training tasks, and turn what works into the recipes behind our production models. You will work closely with the post-training data infrastructure, evaluation, and pre-training teams.

Key Responsibilities

- Design, run, and analyse large-scale RL post-training experiments (e.g., RLHF, RL from verifiable rewards).

- Research and develop methods that improve out-of-distribution generalization, such as reward design, environment and task diversity, curricula, and regularization.

- Build held-out evaluations that measure generalization to unseen tasks, domains, and formats, and that catch reward hacking and benchmark overfitting.

- Diagnose training dynamics and failure modes, including instability, reward over-optimization, and capability regressions.

- Turn successful research into robust, reproducible training recipes for production models.

Qualifications

- Strong research and software engineering skills, with hands-on experience training LLMs.

- Experience applying reinforcement learning to LLMs (e.g., PPO, GRPO, RLHF, RLVR), ideally at scale.

- Track record of work on generalization, robustness, or distribution shift, through publications or shipped models.

- Rigorous experimental practice: clean ablations, careful controls, and sound conclusions from noisy results.

- Experience with distributed training (e.g., JAX, PyTorch, FSDP, Megatron) is a plus.

- Excellent communication skills.

- Deep understanding of data quality principles and best practices: demonstrates willingness to dive deep into data while possessing strong intuition for assessing the quality of datasets and anticipating how different data characteristics will impact model training outcomes.

Working Location
This role can be based remotely or from one of our office locations listed on the job description - there is no minimum in-office qualification requirement. We care most about hiring exceptional people regardless of locations, though please check the location listed on the posting for guidance around the core time zone or working hours alignment expected for the role.

• Work with leading global semiconductor fabs to validate and deploy solutions in high-volume manufacturing environments.

What do we require from you?

• Proven experience in EUV mask, scatterometry, and resist characterization.

• Ability to bridge lithography knowledge with metrology and process control applications.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work across disciplines in a fast-paced R&D environment.

We’re building a world of health around every individual - shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger - helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.
Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Part Time Clinician (Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant) to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.
You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.
Job highlights
The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.
In this role, you will:

• Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

• Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

• Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

• Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

• Conduct virtual visits as needed

• Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:
As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.
Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“I love seeing health plan members at home. You get a better picture of their health when you see where they live.” - Erica R., PA
“At Signify Health, we have the time to help people and to truly listen to their questions and concerns. We can help guide them so they can take better care of themselves. We really can make a change in communities.” - Ali B., NP
“I like how Signify Health manages my experience. I’m just doing the clinician part of my job without all the administrative responsibilities. I have the time to provide education so people have a better understanding of their health. I can answer their questions without rushing out the door.” - Andrew K., PA
Part-time employees qualify for:

• Select benefits (see benefits guide for details)

• Malpractice insurance coverage (during Signify Health-related activities)

• Supplies and other perks

Required & Preferred Qualifications (NPs and PAs)

• Active, unrestricted license(s) in coverage area(s)

• Board certification (required)

• Multi-state licenses (preferred)

description:
We believe that mental health is just as important as physical health. We recognize that mental health issues can be complex and multifaceted, and we are dedicated to treating the whole person, not just the symptoms.

We aim to create a world where mental health is no longer stigmatized or marginalized, but rather is embraced as an integral part of one's overall well-being. 

We believe that by providing quality care that is both evidence-based and compassionate, we can empower individuals to take charge of their mental health and achieve their full potential. We are passionate about making a positive impact on the lives of those struggling with mental health issues and we strive to be a force for positive change in the field of mental healthcare.

Rula is a remote-first company. We currently hire in most U.S. states, with the exception of Hawaii.

About the Role

Rula's business and clinical teams lose hours every week to manual work, and we want AI to give that time back. As a Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, you will sit with a team, learn how the work actually gets done, and ship tools they use every week, often turning a six-to-eight-hour task into under thirty minutes. You stay until the team runs each tool on its own, then turn what you learned into building blocks that help the next team move faster. Because we serve patients in mental health care, privacy is part of the design from day one.

 

Required Qualifications

- Experience & Ownership: 8+ years shipping production-quality software systems (consumer or business) with end-to-end ownership of outcomes.

- Rapid Tool Delivery: Proven track record of shipping tools or products used weekly by customers or business teams, supported by usage telemetry.

- Customer-Centric Discovery: Deep experience learning operational workflows through observation, interviews, or data before designing software solutions.

- AI-Fluency & Engineering Workflow: Daily use of coding agents (specifying, testing, and reviewing output diffs) with rigorous evaluation practices (test sets, evals) and privacy-by-design standards (synthetic/masked data, isolating clinical content from operational tools)

 

Preferred Qualifications

While having the preferred qualifications enhances your candidacy, having all of them is not mandatory. We encourage all interested applicants to apply, even those who may not meet every preferred requirement.

- Measurement Infrastructure: Experience building custom measurement frameworks for cost, usage, and impact tracking when standard vendor dashboards were unavailable.

- Forward-Deployed Experience: Direct prior experience being forward-deployed to non-engineering business teams or external customer organizations.

- Model & Cost Optimization: Practical experience migrating systems across different LLM models to optimize costs while maintaining quality guardrails.

- Integration with Legacy/Messy Systems: Proven ability to integrate AI into complex business platforms with imperfect data/APIs (e.g., CRM, billing, scheduling).

- Technical Enablement: Track record of coaching non-engineering team members to build or adopt software workflows independently.

We're serious about your well-being! As part of our team, full-time employees receive:

title: Radiology Residents: Medical Image Evaluation for AI Benchmarks
description:
WHAT WE'RE RESEARCHING

We're running a paid study on medical imaging diagnostics to build high-quality clinical reference benchmarks. This work directly supports the validation of advanced clinical tools by establishing reliable scoring rubrics based on expert reads. Your input will ensure these evaluations are grounded in rigorous, modern radiological practices.

HOW IT WORKS

You will review a series of de-identified medical images and associated clinical cases through a secure remote platform. For each case, you will provide a detailed expert read and fill out specific scoring rubrics. The task involves evaluating findings, noting diagnostic certainty, and structuring your observations into a standardized reference format. All reviews are conducted asynchronously, allowing you to complete the evaluations at your own pace within the study window.

WHO THIS IS FOR

We are looking for current radiology residents with strong clinical diagnostic skills. We welcome residents across all years of training, as well as those pursuing sub-specialty fellowships in areas like neuroradiology, musculoskeletal, or body imaging. Ideal participants are comfortable navigating digital diagnostic environments and articulating structured clinical findings.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Review de-identified medical images and patient clinical cases

title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work-work that changes the world-is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

The Role

You will join Everpure’s Datastore team to design, develop, and validate embedded firmware for our DirectFlash™ modules. In this role, you will work across firmware and hardware boundaries to build reliable, high-performance storage solutions, while also developing virtual platforms and tooling that accelerate development, debugging, and validation. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional engineering teams to solve complex system-level problems and help deliver innovative products to market.  Comment end   

What You Will Be Doing

Everpure is seeking a full-time Senior Embedded Firmware Engineer to join our device firmware team. You will be responsible for developing high-fidelity virtual platforms that abstract complex hardware behaviors to accelerate SSD firmware development. In this role, you will be responsible for:

• Developing and maintaining comprehensive firmware simulation environments (e.g., QEMU) to enable shift-left testing, reducing dependency on physical hardware and accelerating time-to-market.

• Creating accurate, high-fidelity hardware models to abstract controller logic, communication interfaces (PCIe, NVMe), and NAND media behaviors within Pure Storage’s DirectFlash™ SSD Modules.

• Designing and implementing instrumentation tools to profile performance and analyze failures within the simulated environment.

• Automating CI/CD pipelines to seamlessly integrate simulation and virtual platforms into our firmware release and validation processes.

• Partnering closely with ASIC vendors to validate firmware behaviors against RTL and digital logic designs before physical silicon is available.

• 5+ years of experience building and scaling complex embedded, firmware, or hardware-software systems.

• Expert-level proficiency in C/C++ (object oriented design and C++ 11 and onwards) and strong Python skills for both firmware and modeling development.

• Deep understanding of firmware-hardware interaction, including the ability to translate complex schematics and data sheets into abstract software models.

• Solid Linux (kernel, bootloaders) understanding and ability to root‑cause across HW/FW boundaries.

• Strong knowledge of high-performance storage protocols such as PCIe and NVMe.

• Experience with embedded software development, RTOS and SoC and hardware bring-up.

• Good verbal communication & collaboration skills.

• Must be willing and able to work onsite in an open office and team environment.

A World-Changing Company
 
Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.

The Role
 
Forward Deployed Software Engineers (FDSEs) work directly with customers to quickly understand their greatest problems and design and implement solutions to use data against them. Our customers rely on Palantir’s platforms for some of their most critical operations, and projects often start with an open ended question like “Why are we delaying so many flights?” or “How can we better identify instances of money laundering?” As an FDSE, you’ll apply your problem solving ability, creativity, and technical skills to help organizations use their data to drive a real impact in the world. You’ll have the opportunity to gain rare insight into and contribute to some of the world’s most important industries and institutions.
 
As an FDSE your responsibilities look similar to those of a startup CTO: you’ll work in small teams with minimal supervision and own end-to-end execution of high stakes projects. Your day might span discussing architecture with fellow engineers, wrangling massive-scale data, coding a custom web app, speaking with customer executives, or establishing strategy for your team. 
 
Whether you aspire to be an entrepreneur or an engineering leader, we believe Palantir is the best place - with the best colleagues - to learn how. You’ll learn how to unpack a problem and understand the costs and consequences of its solution. You’ll learn new technologies and languages, and even develop them yourself. You’ll work autonomously and make decisions independently, within a community that will support and challenge you as you grow and develop.

title: Account Executive

FirstPrinciples is building AI to accelerate scientific discovery. Our core product is the Theo Platform, a research environment built to help researchers iterate faster, validate rigorously, and reach verified results they can trust.

We're a fast-growing, remote-first team of builders, researchers, engineers, and thinkers working across Canada, the US, the UK, and expanding globally. What brings us together is a shared curiosity about how the universe works, and a belief that we can build systems that help us explore it more effectively.

We spend our time working on questions that don't have clear answers, like how to design AI that can reason through scientific problems, and how the scientific process as a whole might evolve. This is work that sits somewhere between creativity and rigorous thinking, and often requires comfort with ambiguity and iteration. If you're someone who enjoys tackling big, abstract problems and exploring ideas that don't yet have a defined path forward, you'll likely find the work here interesting.

Why This Role Exists:

We’re building products to accelerate progress in physics - but that only matters if the right researchers discover them, understand how they work, and make the decision to adopt them. Besides building the technology, the challenge is earning the trust of researchers and institutions, and translating it into active usage and commercial relationships.

This role exists to lead that journey. You’ll work across the full sales lifecycle: from identifying and reaching out to researchers and organizations, to discovery, demos, evaluations, and close. - Exceptionally curious and analytical, with the ability to rapidly develop fluency in unfamiliar technical and scientific domains

- Able to form strong, testable points of view from incomplete information, grounded in first-principles reasoning rather than defaulting to established frameworks

We run Hasbro's brands as businesses. Six global categories, each with a named owner, a number and the authority to go after it. We decide what gets made, what gets funded and what gets stopped, and we answer for the result.

We are builders and operators in equal measure. The work spans the consumer insight that starts a line, the product and pricing decisions that shape its margin, and the commercial execution that puts it in someone's hands. The brands are iconic. The job is to make them grow.

About The Role:

We are seeking a Vice President, Board Games to own the global Board Games P&L, a portfolio built on some of the most recognized play experiences in the world, including Monopoly, Jenga, Connect Four, The Game of Life, Clue and Twister. You will lead a team of twelve and report to the SVP, Global Brands.

This role owns Hasbro's physical board game and tabletop portfolio. It is distinct from our digital, video game and trading card businesses, which sit elsewhere in the company, though you will partner with them where a brand lives in more than one place.

This role is based in Boston, Massachusetts, and is onsite three days a week, Tuesday through Thursday. Expect to travel approximately 25% of the time.

This is a general management role. You own the revenue, the margin and the operating profit, and you hold the authority to allocate the investment behind them. Product and North America commercial report to you directly, and every other function partners with you. Finance is your copilot: they bring the expertise, the tools and the information, and the decision stays with you.

In your first year we would expect you to land a credible multi-year plan for the portfolio, make explicit calls on which brands to grow and which to run for profit, and show measurable progress on both the top line and the margin. The mandate is to grow a portfolio of category-defining brands while making it meaningfully more profitable.

A day in the life:

• Own the global Board Games P&L end to end. Carry the revenue, variable margin and operating profit targets, and answer for the return on every dollar you deploy.

• Set the multi-year strategy for the portfolio, making explicit choices about which brands to grow, which to run for profit and which to stop funding.

• Read the global landscape and adjust the plan for it, including macroeconomic conditions, trade and tariff policy, input costs, retail consolidation and shifts in consumer spending across regions.

• Lead with consumer insight, and convert it. Turn what you learn about players and shoppers into specific product, pricing, channel and new business opportunities rather than into research that sits on a shelf.

• Allocate and spend the investment across marketing, tooling, retail activation and A&P, and hold the line on what earns the next dollar.

• Drive product excellence, including the consumer price point each item is designed for and the cost structure that supports it.

title: Assistant General Counsel

R. R. Donnelley & Sons Company (RRD) seeks an experienced contracts attorney to join our team as Assistant General Counsel. The successful candidate will lead complex client contract negotiations and provide strategic legal advice to RRD management. This role requires a highly organized, collaborative practitioner capable of partnering effectively with cross-functional internal teams and external clients.
Key Responsibilities & Legal Capabilities

• Structure, draft, negotiate, and analyze complex client and vendor agreements.

• Draft and negotiate commercial technology agreements, including intellectual property licenses, software licensing/support, SaaS, cloud computing, artificial intelligence (AI) implementations, development, outsourcing, and consulting agreements.

title: Co-Founder & CEO — AI-Native Accounting Firm
description:
The Opportunity
FutureSight is seeking a Co-Founder & CEO to leadFieldstone, an AI-native accounting firm. This is a co-founder partnership with meaningful founder equity, not a salaried executive role.
Fieldstoneis an accounting firm built from a blank page around an agent fleet. Agents run bookkeeping, reconciliation, workpapers, and first-pass tax returns continuously, and every human in the firm sits in a reviewer seat: applying judgment, signing off, and owning the client relationship. You bring your client relationships and your craft. A FutureSight technical co-founder works alongside you inside the practice, automating the work as you do it, so the product is built from real engagements from day one.
Market Context
US accounting services is a $150B industry, with an estimated $29B serviceable market across 900K US and Canadian businesses in the $1-20M revenue band. Demand is growing while supply collapses: over 300,000 accountants have left the profession since 2020, CPA exam candidates are down more than 30% over the past decade, and roughly 75% of active CPAs are retirement-eligible. Regional firms are turning away mid-market clients because they no longer have the capacity to serve them. That is Fieldstone's entry point.
About FutureSight

FutureSight is a leading venture builder that co-creates world-class software companies with values-driven entrepreneurs from inception to exit. We are a team of founders, operators and designers with experience successfully bringing software to market at scale.
You’ll co-create with a proven venture building team, led by John Carbrey (4x entrepreneur, $100M ARR), Krista LaRiviere (3x exited, E&Y Top Women Entrepreneur), Alan Smith (Strategyzer co-founder, $120M in products built), Prathna Ramesh (former MD of Maple Leaf Angels, $275M in follow-on capital), and Johnny Tong (0-to-1 builder, acquired by SAP and Stripe) bring a rare combination of operator exits, institutional investing, and AI product depth.
The Partnership

• Founder equity with meaningful ownership from inception

• Pre-seed capital committed by FutureSight for early hires and agent development, with potential for follow-on funding

• A technical co-founder embedded in your practice from day one, building the agent fleet around your workflow

• Venture building resources, including design, engineering, growth, and fundraising support from day one

• Investor and advisor network across fintech and early-stage capital markets

• A true co-creation model in which you operate as CEO with FutureSight 's cross-functional team as your partner

What You’ll Own
As Co-Founder & CEO, you will set the venture's direction and lead its execution.

• Clients: Bring over your founding client base and win new mid-market clients through your network

• Practice: Own quality of work, review standards, and every client relationship as the firm's lead CPA

• Product: Work side by side with the technical co-founder, turning your daily workflow into agents and your review corrections into accuracy gains

• Licensing: Lead firm registration and CPA licensing across US states

• Capital: Lead the seed raise, supported by FutureSight 's network and traction

• Team: Hire reviewer CPAs and establish the cultural foundation of the firm

Co-Founder Profile

• Licensed US CPA with partner or senior manager experience at an accounting firm

• An established book of client relationships you can bring into a new firm

• Hands-on experimentation with AI tools in your own practice, and conviction that the firm model needs to change

• Strong business development track record, winning and retaining clients on the strength of your work

• Product mindset, with the curiosity to break down your own workflow and shape how it gets automated

• Ability to build an investor narrative and close capital with FutureSight 's support

• Experience in bookkeeping, tax, and advisory for 1M-20M businesses

The Sr. Controls Engineer - OT SCADA Projects leads the design, configuration, commissioning, and support of plant control systems for utility-scale solar, storage, and hybrid renewable energy projects. This engineer works with minimal oversight, applies expert knowledge of grid functionality and Utility/ISO standards, mentors junior engineers, and contributes to product standards. Approximately 80% of this role is project execution, while up to 20% is continuous improvement and product development.

• Deliver high-quality work independently across multiple concurrent projects with ownership and urgency

• Leverage standardized platforms and tools to work efficiently

• Ensure 100% adherence to Terabase quality processes; enforce standards with junior engineers

• Mentor junior controls engineers through technical guidance, code review, and FAT coaching

• Project deliverables completed on time, within scope, and meeting Utility/ISO regulato

title: Power Platform Technical Lead
description:
A significant share of the work in this role is matching the exact behavior of real, already-deployed legacy and Power Platform systems from their own source exports, not just building new features from a blank slate. This role therefore calls for both strong Power Platform delivery expertise and a reverse-engineering mindset.
Responsibilities

• Design and build Dataverse schemas, Power Automate flows, security roles, and generative code pages for Power Platform modernization workstreams.

• Decode and faithfully replicate the behavior of existing, already-deployed systems by reading their exported source directly, not just working from requirements documents.

• Go beyond no-code and low-code tooling when needed by authoring raw Dataverse Web API and metadata calls, debugging flows through run history and API tooling, and diagnosing undocumented platform behavior through direct testing.

• Own the technical integrity of cross-environment integrations, JIT identity provisioning, service-account patterns, and the security model, including roles and privilege scoping.

• Identify and clearly document design divergences from source systems, distinguishing verified behavior, new functionality, accepted simplifications, and assumptions.

• Mentor and direct supporting developers, review flow and schema designs for correctness and maintainability, and provide hands-on coding guidance.

• Maintain a living requirements-traceability record mapping what is built against the authoritative requirement source.

Requirements
Required Skills and Experience
Screen for concrete, demonstrable experience in each area below. 5+ years of Power Platform experience alone is not a sufficient filter for this role.

• 5+ years of hands-on Power Platform and Dataverse delivery experience, including at least one engagement involving custom Power Automate flows and Dataverse security configuration beyond default settings.

• Experience as a hands-on technical lead who mentors developers, works alongside the team, and demonstrates implementation approaches in practice.

• Direct experience with Dataverse Web API and metadata operations, including creating or modifying tables, columns, and relationships through Web API calls rather than only through the Maker UI.

• Hands-on experience with Workflow Definition Language expressions, connection references, webhook trigger subscription registration, and debugging flows through run history and API tooling rather than only the visual designer.

• Strong experience configuring Dataverse security architecture, including security roles, table-level privilege scoping, business units, teams, JIT user provisioning, and service-principal or dedicated service-account patterns.

• Experience with cross-environment Dataverse integration using OAuth client credentials and secret management.

• Experience building Power Apps code apps or generative pages with React, TypeScript, and component libraries, with an understanding of platform-specific data-binding conventions.

• Experience with advanced PAC CLI operations beyond basic solution export and import, including metadata operations, environment variables, connection references, and solution component management.

• Experience unpacking and reading exported Power Platform solution contents to determine how an existing system behaves in practice.

• Experience troubleshooting platform behavior through deliberate live-environment testing when documentation alone is insufficient.

• Availability during Hawaii Standard Time business hours.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with public-sector or government modernization.

• Experience designing audit- and compliance-grade data trails.

• Familiarity with Dataverse auditing settings and edge cases.

• PL-600 or PL-400 certification.
